external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Thomas is an authentic guide, coach, and friend. I mentored business students/professionals alongside Thomas at the SFU Beedie School of Business; he has a magnetic personality and perseverance that is second to none. During my ups and downs, Thomas has listened to me and provided sound coaching advice and guidance to overcome personal and professional obstacles. I applaud him for his new venture, and recommend him for his services.

Mentoring is the drive to help others recognize their potential and guiding them achieve it. That is preciously what Thomas has done for a number of BCIT Students as part of the BCITSA Mentorship Program, which I help facilitate.
